features.name: Workspace Switching and Data Isolation
steps: Create or switch to Workspace B
Sidebar, private pages, teamspaces, library content, and member context all switch to Workspace B
Restore A's original content and state without leaking data between workspaces
features.expected: Switching workspaces must swap sidebar, private pages, teamspaces, library, and member context; switching back restores the original state without leaking data between workspaces.

features.name: Teamspace Management
steps: Configure default teamspace and access rules
Teamspace appears in sidebar and library
Resource visibility configuration and available actions update consistently
features.expected: Teamspace must appear in sidebar and library; settings changes update visibility configuration and available actions; configuration persists.

features.name: Create Page / Create Database with Destination Context
steps: Select Private or a Teamspace as the destination
Choose an existing data source, create a new page, or create a blank database
The new resource appears in the correct sidebar, library, or database context
features.expected: New resource must appear in the correct sidebar, library, or database context matching the selected destination.

features.name: Page Editing and Autosave
features.expected: Saving completes automatically; reopening shows the latest content; refreshing the browser keeps the content.

features.name: Move Page Across Locations
steps: Select Notes, Documents, Meetings, Projects, Tasks, or a Teamspace
Page disappears from the original location and appears in the destination
Sidebar position, library source, and access scope update consistently
features.expected: Page must disappear from the original location and appear in the destination; sidebar position, library source, and access scope update consistently.

features.name: Page Sharing Settings
steps: Start with a private or team page
Shared state is displayed on the page
features.expected: Share settings save and display the shared state; revoking updates projections; settings persist.

features.name: Favorites
steps: Open Page A in an unfavorited state
Open the same page from another location
Page disappears from Favorites without deleting the page
features.expected: Favorite state persists across all locations; removing from Favorites does not delete the page.

features.name: Recent Pages and Visit Activity
steps: Open multiple private and team pages
Pages are ordered by recent activity
Its last-visited timestamp and ranking update automatically
features.expected: Recent list must order pages by activity; reopening a page updates its last-visited timestamp and ranking.

features.name: Trash Lifecycle
steps: Move a normal page to Trash
Page disappears from its original location and standard database views
Find the page using search or filters such as last editor, page type, or teamspace
Keep the deleted page isolated during the retention period
Apply permanent deletion when retention expires
features.expected: Deleted page disappears from its original location and standard views; Trash search and filters find it; retention keeps it isolated; permanent deletion applies when retention expires.

features.name: Version History and Page Restore
steps: Edit the same page multiple times
Current page content changes to the selected version while preserving page identity, URL, location, and permissions
features.expected: Restoring a version must change content to the selected version while preserving page identity, URL, location, and permissions.

features.name: Library Aggregation
steps: Maintain resources across Private pages and Teamspaces
Switch among Teamspaces, Recent, Favorites, Shared, and Private
The same underlying page appears in the correct derived collections based on location, access, favorite state, and activity without creating duplicate resources
features.expected: The same page must appear in correct derived collections based on location, access, favorite state, and activity without duplicates.

features.name: Database Creation and Data Sources
steps: Create a database from the unified creation flow
Choose Private or a Teamspace as the destination
Database appears in the selected location and Library
Later creation flows can reuse it as an existing data source
features.expected: Database must appear in the selected location and Library; it becomes reusable as a data source in later creation flows.

features.name: Database Views over Shared Records
steps: Create or switch between views such as All Tasks / By Status or Card / Table
Each view maintains independent layout and visible properties
All views immediately reflect the updated record
features.expected: Views must share the same underlying records; each view keeps independent layout and properties; edits reflect immediately in all views.

features.name: Database Filtering, Sorting, and Search
steps: Open a database with multiple records
Search within the current result set
Recompute the visible records from the combined query state
Restore the original view, filters, sorting, and search context
features.expected: Visible records must recompute from the combined query state; navigating back restores the original view, filters, sorting, and search context.

features.name: Database Properties and Record Editing
steps: Edit a record property such as Status, Date, Person, Tag, or Relation
Open another view of the same database
Filters, grouping, sorting, and other derived views recompute from the new property value
features.expected: Edited property values persist; derived views recompute from the new values.

features.name: Project–Task–Meeting–Document Relations
steps: Link Tasks, Meetings, and Documents to the project
Navigate from the project to a related record
Both sides of the relation update consistently without duplicating records
features.expected: Linked objects must display on the project record; navigating to related records works; edits or removals update both sides without duplicating records.

features.name: Task Status Workflow and Status Views
steps: Assign a status such as Next or Done and set a due date
Task appears in All Tasks and the appropriate status-based view
Task automatically moves into the corresponding derived group while retaining its other properties
features.expected: Tasks must appear in All Tasks and status-based views; changing status moves the task to the corresponding group while retaining other properties.

features.name: Meeting Participants and Personalized Views
steps: Set creation time, participants, and related Project
If the current user is a participant, it also appears in My Meetings
Personalized and project-linked views update automatically
features.expected: Meetings must appear in All Meetings; participant-based views include the current user when applicable; changing participants or relations updates views automatically.

features.name: Document Metadata and Multi-view Consistency
steps: Add metadata such as tags or type
Display it in a card-based document view
Both views reference the same underlying record
All views and related Projects update consistently
features.expected: Both card and table views must reference the same record; metadata or content edits update all views and related Projects consistently.

features.name: Workspace Settings and Global Configuration
steps: Change workspace name, icon, or default landing page
Workspace selector and related UI update globally
features.expected: Settings changes update the workspace selector and related UI globally; configuration remains active after refresh or reopen.
